title: Top Contributors This Week sidebar on ForumPage

context_files.reason: Composition, pure functions for data transforms
Type safety, Promise.all for parallel queries

acceptance_criteria: Sidebar renders on ForumPage (right side on desktop, below topics on mobile)
Shows top 10 contributors by post count in last 7 days
Each row: MiniAvatar, username, post count, role badge
Service function `getTopContributors()` queries forum_posts grouped by author_id, filtered to last 7 days, joined with users table
Loading state: skeleton placeholders while query runs
Empty state: 'No posts this week yet — start a conversation!'
Sidebar has a subtle border-left, `position: sticky` on desktop, max-height with overflow-y scroll
Uses `Promise.all` for parallel data fetching where applicable
